note: The Thủy Vân peoples' body marks on today's body (peoples_design 2.4 and 2.8): the `trait`, `tint` and `reflect_eye` blocks the six people rows of data/customizer/thuyvan_peoples.json take (CharacterPeoples.trait_of / people(); BodyMaterials.set_trait and eye_material read them), the rite's ash markings, and the Hồ Tinh features (fox_features.json). Visual only: no row is a stat, nothing is locked to a people (anyone may wear the ash marks; the fur colours and tail count are free), and every face, skin tone and hair of the creator stays a choice for every people. Maps: assets/thuyvan/character/traits (tools/thuyvan_art/traits/trait_maps.py); shader: assets/thuyvan/shaders/tv_traits.gdshaderinc.
